status: All 26 research packages and narrated videos complete; local verification and independent integration closure review complete.

entries.title: Common quartets in evolutionary trees
entries.result: h(3)=14; a single-exponential general upper bound with base (1+sqrt(13))/2; 23<=h(4)<=28.
entries.limits: Lean checks only the sharp potential inequality and equality witness. Global optimality and h(4) remain open.

entries.title: Rigidity of the 92 Johnson solids
entries.result: 47 locally rigid and 45 flexible under fixed edge lengths and planar faces.
entries.limits: Local rigidity in the stated model, not rigidity of the bare edge graph or global uniqueness.

entries.title: Distance-three qudit stabilizer codes
entries.result: Complete admissible lengths for F_q-linear stabilizer codes, q>=3; twelve pinned table entries improve, eleven become exact.
entries.limits: Known endpoint families and support-removal methods are credited. Nonlinear codes and general additive non-prime-field codes are outside the classification.

entries.title: Chemical robustness with multiple stable states
entries.result: Minimum stoichiometric dimension three and six complexes for ACR with multistability in at-most-bimolecular networks.
entries.limits: The species-three construction is elementary; reaction-count minimum is open. Lean checks examples and ACR, not stability or the general lower bounds.

entries.title: A finite covering-system obstruction
entries.result: No finite distinct covering with all moduli at least six dividing 2^a*45, for any a.
entries.limits: The odd-part-135/minimum-eight extension is excluded.

entries.title: Winning permutation races by rotation
entries.result: Right rotation beats every permutation of length at least three under independent continuous observations.
entries.limits: The rotation is a winning reply, not necessarily the optimal reply.

entries.title: Why integer tree-balance weights fail
entries.result: Nonnegative weights with f(2), f(3), f(4) in one cyclic real lattice cannot yield a sound Colless-like index.
entries.limits: The result does not exclude all real-valued weights.

entries.title: Periodic symplectic billiards in special octagons
entries.result: Every orbit is periodic for special lattice octagons and mirror-symmetric Hexhouses, with an explicit bound.
entries.limits: Asymmetric Hexhouses and general Penthouses remain open.

entries.title: Infinite words avoiding Cartesian-tree squares
entries.result: Explicit binary and ternary morphisms settle the source's remaining infinite-word table entries.
entries.limits: The long-word deduction is written mathematics with independently checked finite cases, not a Lean theorem.

entries.title: Reduced graphs with four negative eigenvalues
entries.result: The maximum reduced order is 30; higher ranks are excluded and two positive-inertia extremizers are classified.
entries.limits: The four order-30 rank-eight graphs and the numerical bound A4=11 were already known.

entries.title: How cheaply can the first player win Hex?
entries.result: Certified lambda(5)=lambda*(5)=6, delta(5)=7, delta(6)=10 and lambda(6)>=8.
entries.limits: The matching lambda(6)<=8 is search-only. No strict-rule value at six is claimed.

entries.title: Bridge and meridional rank of thirteen-crossing knots
entries.result: Twenty-five entries in a pinned 293-name list have bridge number and meridional rank four.
entries.limits: Novel relative to the pinned list; overlap with broader family theorems remains a priority question.

entries.title: Exact resistance to three-team tournament manipulation
entries.result: Optimal coalition gain 2/5 for five through eight teams, with exact monotone top-cycle-consistent rules.
entries.limits: Finite cases only; the all-size question remains open and lower bounds are prior work.

entries.title: Response bounds on cactus networks
entries.result: The topological response conjecture holds on all cacti; a stronger coupling method fails on graphs with a K4 minor.
entries.limits: The obstruction concerns the method, not a counterexample to the general response conjecture.

entries.title: Bilinear complexity over small finite fields
entries.result: mu_q(2,2)=mu_q^sym(2,2): 9 for q=2, 8 for q=3,4,5, and 7 for q>=7; binary length-six cyclic convolution has rank 12.
entries.limits: The symmetric binary value, q=4 claim and search methods have prior sources; novelty is narrower than the full table.

entries.title: An eleven-neuron stable nonclique network
entries.result: An exact standard-parameter counterexample is minimal under vertex deletion; the global minimum lies from eight to eleven.
entries.limits: Standard-parameter counterexamples were already implied by prior families. Eleven is not proved globally minimal.

entries.title: Certified rings around marked tiles
entries.result: Thirty-four exact maxima over unbalanced single-slot lattice markings, with witnesses and checked exclusion proofs.
entries.limits: No new Heesch record or off-grid upper bound; overlap with smaller prior tables remains unresolved.

entries.title: A shorter certificate for seven-cube tic-tac-toe
entries.result: A Hall-surplus proof of the known Breaker win repairs omissions in the published case analysis.
entries.limits: Six-cube and five-cube games remain open; Lean covers the abstract matching lemmas only.

entries.title: Counting staircase Latin tableaux
entries.result: An independently checked induction gives 9*4^(k-3), with a 576-tableau base case.
entries.limits: An earlier public proof has the same formula and four-extension mechanism. No novelty claim.

entries.title: Generic three-dimensional stiffness recovery
entries.result: Generic density-normalized stiffness is determined by eleven generic wave-measurement directions.
entries.limits: Full geometric proof is not formalized; stable inversion and optimal direction count remain open.

entries.title: Prime-successor Hales-Jewett numbers
entries.result: HJ(p+1,2;2)=p+1 for every prime p, with a complete Lean proof.
entries.limits: The off-diagonal convention matters; the source's geometric G(8,2) computation is not independently certified.

entries.title: Local rigidity of the truncated dodecahedron
entries.result: An exact higher-order certificate proves local rigidity with fixed edges and planar faces.
entries.limits: Does not prove global uniqueness or rigidity with only bar constraints.

entries.title: A periodic waiting-time entropy counterexample
entries.result: A smooth three-state counterexample to a specific forward-protocol entropy-bound conjecture.
entries.limits: Protocol-reversal results remain intact; the broad false-positive mechanism has prior examples.

entries.title: Sharp equilibrium counts from cubic sources
entries.result: An all-n family attains the sharp equilibrium count; source molecularity three is sufficient and minimal.
entries.limits: Classes are unbounded, product molecularities may exceed three, and simultaneous stability is unproved.

entries.title: Global optimality of conjugate restart laws
entries.result: A global renewal-law optimum and uniqueness result, with a finite-state converse under cyclicity.
entries.limits: The kernel inequality and exponential conjugate pair are prior work; priority remains provisional.

entries.title: Reconstructing generic Lotka-Volterra trees
entries.result: A self-contained reconstruction and verification note with an exact path-obstruction lemma.
entries.limits: An earlier withdrawn announcement closely overlaps; no priority claim.
